artifact: A service catches Exception and returns null for every failure, losing cause and making callers treat faults as not-found.
A pure 12-line helper validates its input, has explicit return type, focused tests and no duplicated side effects.
Approved concept was distinctive editorial healthcare, but implementation replaces it with black+gold, glass cards, centered giant hero and fade-up-everything without rationale.
Implementation follows approved tokens, hierarchy, mobile recomposition and motion purpose; long-content and empty states are demonstrated.
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is added to the browser bundle so the UI can bypass RLS.
Authenticated endpoint uses server-side authorization, parameterized SQL, runtime schema validation and no secrets in client/logs.
Dashboard loops over 500 rows and performs one remote/database request per row on the request path; p95 regressed from 400ms to 9s.
Critical endpoint p50/p95/p99 and load profile were measured before/after; payload and query counts are bounded and budget remains satisfied.
New E2E test fails intermittently; CI is changed to rerun it five times until green and no root cause is investigated.
Bug reproduction is deterministic, a regression test fails before the fix and passes after it, with boundary integration coverage.
Production release contains destructive migration, no restore test or roll-forward path; only application rollback is documented.
Candidate commit equals tested artifact; migration compatibility, rollback/data recovery, smoke checks, alerts and abort criteria are verified for production.
